1. Extend the image with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
2. Start with f equal to the extended image and h a Gaussian of sigma, cut to the support.
3. Run the PSF steps with f fixed. After each one, apply the support, set negative weights to 0 and scale the sum to 1.
4. Run the image steps with h fixed, as in Richardson-Lucy.
5. Repeat for the chosen number of cycles.
6. Crop the image to its size, or show the PSF.
